purpose: Future source-provenance correction that retains every original exclusion observation while separately binding the actual prepared source. No current capture qualification or guard override.

observed_gap.source_explanation: Pinned HV removes a selected host-owned subtree and selected first logging rows before the prepared base is captured; the independent diagnosis proves only the restricted inventoried-property projection.
observed_gap.limit: Four removed physical observations are numerically below the current native RAM envelope; that neither establishes global exclusion coverage nor permits dropping them from future conservative facts. No raw addresses, captured path/name strings or property bytes are emitted here.

selected_minimum_profile.inputs: Separate immutable ORIGINAL raw ADT, PREPARED base raw ADT, original736 BootArgs, final native1152 BootArgs, full384 MCC, existing selected-image/context labels and existing reviewed allocation. No reconstructed missing source.
selected_minimum_profile.host_dataflow: Frozen capture already returns original_adt alongside original_bootargs/mcc_raw. Current prepare passes only base_blob to measure/produce. A NEW isolated producer/helper revision must pass both actual bytes to measure and produce; no extra device acquisition is needed for this design.
selected_minimum_profile.first_gate: Use the frozen extractor independently on both actual byte strings, preserving all properties, original row order and multiplicity. Require exact supported DRAM/VRAM/root-translation source consistency, original/native envelope and existing video/boot-prefix checks unchanged.
selected_minimum_profile.projection_gate: Require the exact restricted transformation proof for the pinned HV source and required captured source-selection context, over inventoried properties. Every unchanged property remains byte-exact; only source-defined selected-subtree deletion and selected first-row removal may explain the observed subset. Unknown changed/prepared-only rows, extra removals, unsupported selection or missing witness refuse. This is not a full-ADT replay or quiescence proof.
selected_minimum_profile.subset_gate: For each prepared pmap occurrence, find one distinct original occurrence at the same source property identity with identical complete raw record. For segments, compare the same private node identity, complete32-byte raw row and corresponding display-label bytes; preserve duplicate occurrences. Slot shifts are allowed only as entailed by the exact projection, recorded explicitly in the map. Match whole segment rows once and reuse that mapping for physical and numerical-remap observations, never match their numeric spans independently.
selected_minimum_profile.mapping: Deterministic per-class/per-origin ordinal maps, injective within the prepared origin; each map target identifies an unchanged original ordinal. Do not share two prepared occurrences with one original occurrence, collapse same-source duplicates, compare only an address, or treat display labels as unique identities.
selected_minimum_profile.emission: Emit ALL original pmap/physical/numerical-remap observations in their original deterministic order and boundaries. Original dense ordinals stay unchanged. Prepared source is independently retained with its own raw hash/counts and subset map; it is not discarded, relabelled as original or reserialized into an alleged raw capture.
selected_minimum_profile.why_conservative: Prepared is proved an occurrence-preserving subset of original, so the conservative set of source exclusions is exactly the full original list. No generic merge/dedup/append branch is needed or admitted. Any prepared-only or changed observation refuses instead of trying to salvage a union.
selected_minimum_profile.unchanged_other_classes: Full original384 MCC/coverage and exact enabled-slot records remain unchanged. The single VRAM allocation must agree across the sources; retained boot reservation derives only from final native BootArgs. Numerical remaps, including zero, stay source-only and never enter the physical exclusion union.

wire_and_core_reuse.facts908e_layout_and_freestanding_decode: Can remain unchanged ONLY under the explicit host-provenance interpretation below. Header1280/32-byte records/max9472/count256 and six descriptors remain literal. No reserved-byte, flags or auxiliary repurposing.
wire_and_core_reuse.six_identity_labels: Keep literal existing order: selected KC, ramdisk, pinned HV source, actual PREPARED base ADT, original BootArgs, final native BootArgs. In particular the base-ADT slot must not be replaced by an original or composite hash. Same-boot nonce remains separate. No invented seventh verified identity.
wire_and_core_reuse.class_source_digests: NEW producer profile uses explicit fixed domain-separated dual-origin digest framing for ADT-derived classes2/3/4/5. Commit class tag/profile, actual original and prepared raw ADT hashes, separately framed exact relevant raw property bytes/provenance, both source cardinalities, every injective map entry, emitted original row order and wire count. Length/count framing is mandatory; preserve private exact bytes and deterministic maps for independent recomputation. MCC/raw384 and final boot-prefix source digests keep their existing distinct interpretations.
wire_and_core_reuse.private_receipt: Return/persist both raw-source hashes, separate source inventories/counts/digests and the complete integer ordinal map in a bounded private join receipt, tied to nonce and the same measure/produce result. Maps can be bounded by two existing256-record input capacities; choose an explicit small metadata byte cap before implementation. Raw captures remain private; public summary exposes counts/hashes/status only.
wire_and_core_reuse.guest_scope: Guest908e sees conservative original rows plus opaque composite source labels, not independently enumerated original/prepared raw sources or per-origin digests. Existing C checks cannot authenticate caller metadata, recompute absent raw inputs, establish completeness/quiescence or prove the projection. A future independent host-side qualifier must recompute both inventories, projection, map, emitted rows and composite digests from the actual saved sources.
wire_and_core_reuse.native_owner: No private_lifecycle/native-owner/reader policy arithmetic change is required for these unchanged physical intervals. Existing exact union8/whole-RAM containment/retention rules remain authoritative, not successful unsupported stubs. No hardware or device effect is added.

actual_pair_capacity_analysis_only.scope: Computed read-only with the frozen extractor on the two actual saved inputs; no new wire produced or old P2 run. Not a future universal capacity promise.

capacity_and_refusal.hard_limits: Validate both complete source inventories independently, then full emitted record count including MCC/VRAM/boot must fit256; exact relevant physical exclusion union must fit8. Never truncate, discard below-RAM source rows, inward-clip, fill holes, merge original RAM boundaries, or widen RAM to DRAM. Overflow/missing/partial/unknown/raw-MCC80/invalid384/capacity errors retain existing refusal semantics.
capacity_and_refusal.measure_before_native_encode: Both-source checks and exact size must run during measure and repeat during produce; identities, maps/counts/bytes must remain identical between calls. Existing9472 max-facts capacity reservation remains sufficient as a bound; never resize original ADT allocation or alter placement to make a join fit.

when_wire_v2_is_required: If the contract requires the guest to independently receive separate original-ADT identity, origin-specific digests/cardinalities or per-record origin memberships, facts-v1 cannot represent that honestly. Introduce an explicit new wire version/profile with reviewed decoder/reader/workspace/capacities/identity APIs. Do not hide fields in v1 reserved bytes, silently redefine its base identity, or claim a composite digest independently exposes each source.
future_validation_required: Separate immutable producer/helper/host opt-in profile and new criteria; old profile001/current capture remain unchanged and unqualified.

Synthetic exact projection/subset positive with removed observations retained in emitted ORIGINAL rows; unexpected new/changed row, unknown deletion/selection, absent original source and changed-byte witnesses must refuse.

Repeated full rows/display labels and shifted slots: preserve every original duplicate, injective prepared occurrence map, no cross-node or range-only matching. Zero/high opaque IOVA and zero numerical remaps retain their original meaning.

Identity/provenance negatives: swap origins, alter either raw input/digest/count/map/order, ambiguous framed encoding, or change after measure; all refuse. Independently recompute composite digest without importing producer semantics.

Capacity256/257, exact union8/9 and full interval/RAM adjacency oracles; no row skipped because it currently falls outside RAM. A synthetic omitted original interval inside eligible RAM must be caught even where prepared lacks it.

Independent future end-to-end source-only tests must show existing C908e decoder receives exact intended records and unchanged six identity labels. Guest acceptance is structural, not authentication. No actual target execution is part of this design.
